payload.body: Swift and Android publication workflows are present in source: publish-swift.yml mirrors packages/swift to FrickSwift on swift-v* tags, and publish-android.yml publishes the Android SDK to GitHub Packages on android-v* tags. Recent release docs now describe both flows; remaining release-engineering work lives in FR-8/FR-51 and current workflow hardening rather than this pipeline story.
